insert into vm_emergency_user (user_id, emergency_dept_id, tenant_id, creator, create_time, app_ver_code, industry_code) values
( #{item.userId}, #{item.emergencyDeptId}, #{item.tenantId}, #{item.creator}, NOW(), #{item.appVerCode}, #{item.industryCode} )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM vm_emergency_user WHERE emergency_dept_id IN (SELECT id FROM vm_emergency_dept WHERE event_code = #{digitalId} AND delete_flag = 0 AND commander_flag <> 1)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM (SELECT USER_ID AS emergencyUserId, NICK_NAME AS emergencyUserName, USER_NAME AS emergencyUserAccount, IF(PHONENUMBER, CONCAT(SUBSTRING(PHONENUMBER, 1, 3), '****', SUBSTRING(PHONENUMBER, 8)), NULL) AS phoneNumber, IF(SUBSTRING(NICK_NAME, 1, 1) REGEXP '[一-龥]', firstPinyin(NICK_NAME), SUBSTRING(NICK_NAME, 1, 1)) AS nickNameGbk FROM sys_user WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0 AND USER_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM vm_emergency_user WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND emergency_dept_id = #{emergencyDeptId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND industry_code = #{industryCode})) AS subquery ORDER BY nickNameGbk

SELECT su.USER_ID AS emergencyUserId, su.NICK_NAME AS emergencyUserName, su.USER_NAME AS emergencyUserAccount, vfc.dispatch_desk_num as dispatchDeskNum, vfc.mobile_terminal_num AS mobileTerminalNum FROM sys_user su left join vm_fusion_communication_t vfc on su.USER_ID = vfc.user_id WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0 AND su.USER_NAME = #{userName} limit 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vm_emergency_user WHERE emergency_dept_id IN (SELECT id FROM vm_emergency_dept WHERE event_code = #{eventCode} AND delete_flag = 0) AND delete_flag = 0;

SELECT t2.user_id,t3.user_name, t3.nick_name nickName, CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(t3.nick_name, 1, 1) REGEXP '[一-龥]' THEN firstPinyin(t3.nick_name) ELSE SUBSTRING(t3.nick_name, 1, 1) END AS sortName, t3.PHONENUMBER phoneNumber ,t1.emergency_dept_name,t1.id deptId FROM vm_emergency_dept t1 LEFT JOIN vm_emergency_user t2 ON t1.id = t2.emergency_dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_user t3 ON t3.user_id = t2.user_id WHERE t1.delete_flag = 0 AND t2.delete_flag = 0 AND t3.DEL_FLAG = 0 AND t1.commander_flag <> 1 AND t1.event_code = #{eventCode} ORDER BY IF(SUBSTRING(t3.nick_name, 1, 1) RLIKE '^[a-z]', 1, 2), CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(t3.nick_name, 1, 1) REGEXP '[一-龥]' THEN firstPinyin(t3.nick_name) ELSE SUBSTRING(t3.nick_name, 1, 1) END
